title: Heal
prompt: The starter has a member `health` at 50 and a `take_damage` helper. Add a `heal` helper that adds an amount to health. In `solve`, call heal(20). Then return health, which is 70.
hints: heal is the mirror of take_damage.

docs.name: var name = value (outside any function)
docs.what: A variable at the top of the script (a member variable): every function in the script can read and change it.
